'''''Star Wars: The High Republic''''' is a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series by [[Cavan Scott]] released as part of the ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic]]'' multimedia project. The series will serve as the flagship comic series for Phase III of the multimedia project. The [[The High Republic (2023) 1|first issue]] was published by [[Marvel Comics]] in [[November]] [[2023]].

The series focuses on [[Keeve Trennis]]'s life as a [[Jedi Master]],<ref name="Dealing with Grief">{{Twitter|YogiKai|status/1682492942743912449|For Light & Life|quote=@cavanscott is describing the 3rd series will focus on Keeve’s life as a Jedi Master and dealing with grief #HighRepublic|archivedate=20230723133945}}</ref> coming to terms with her new rank as a mirror to her coming to terms with being a [[Jedi Knight]] in [[The High Republic (2021) 1|''The High Republic'' (2021) 1]].<ref name="Coming to terms">{{Twitter|StarWarsExplain|status/1682492714921914368|Star Wars Explained|quote=Cavan’s Phase Three comic will be about Keeve coming to terms with becoming a Jedi Master, mirroring her first issue coming to terms with becoming a Jedi Knight.|archivedate=20230723134239}}</ref> The series also focuses on her dealing with grief.<ref name="Dealing with Grief" />
